hero.html: - Introduce yourself: Kenneth Foo, Manager, Partner Solutions Architecture.
cover.html:
- Elastic is one platform with three solutions: Search & AI, Observability and Security.
- Goal for today: know what each solution does, who buys it, how to spot the opportunity, and who we compete with.
platform.html:
- Any data in: cloud, apps, collaboration tools, security products. Structured or not.
- Everything lands in the same Elasticsearch platform: ingest, process, store, search, AI/ML, visualize, agents and workflows.
- Customers either build their own app or use one of the three solutions.
- Deploy anywhere: self-managed, Elastic Cloud Hosted or Serverless.
solutions.html:
- Each solution is recognized as a Leader by at least one major analyst.
- Search & AI: hybrid search, vector DB and embeddings in one engine, plus a huge developer ecosystem.
- Observability: cost efficiency and an open, OpenTelemetry-first approach.
- Security: resource-based pricing means full coverage, plus SOAR and AI-driven response.
analysts.html:
- Where Elastic sits in each analyst report.
- Search & AI: Leader, Forrester Wave Cognitive Search Platforms Q4 2025; also a Leader in IDC MarketScape General-Purpose Knowledge Discovery 2025.
- Observability: Leader, 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Observability Platforms, second year running.
- Security: Visionary, 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM; Leader, Forrester Wave Security Analytics Platforms Q2 2025.
- The charts are schematics, not the analyst graphics.
features.html:
- One line per feature so you can explain it to a customer.
- Search & AI is about finding things and grounding AI. Observability is about every signal from apps and infrastructure. Security is about detecting and responding to threats.
in-action.html:
- The same features, working together.
- Search & AI: sources are embedded, stored as text and vectors, retrieved with hybrid search, and fed to the LLM with RAG.
- Observability: one request seen as user experience, LLM calls, a trace, logs and infrastructure metrics, all through OpenTelemetry. AIOps points to the root cause.
- Security: alerts from every source hit the SIEM, Attack Discovery collapses them into one attack, SOAR responds and isolates the host.
personas.html:
- Match the business card to the solution.
- Developers and AI/ML engineers: Search & AI. SREs, DevOps and infrastructure teams: Observability. SOC, security and compliance teams: Security.
use-cases.html:
- These are the phrases to listen for in discovery.
- Each quote maps to the capability to lead with, shown in blue.
competitive.html:
- When you see these incumbents in an account, there is an Elastic conversation to have.
- Lead with the Elastic edge under each column.
upgrade.html:
- For customers already running Elastic: the features that justify an upgrade.
- Platform-wide: searchable snapshots and frozen tier, AI/ML and EIS, 24/7 support, enterprise security features.
why-unified.html:
- Takeaway 1: unified within, unified across.
- Within Observability: metrics, logs and traces become one store.
- Within Security: SIEM, XDR, SOAR and UEBA become one stack.
- Across: both solutions sit on the same data, which is what makes DevSecOps practical.
why-ai.html:
- Takeaway 2: AI-driven.
- Agent Builder lets customers build agents on their own data.
- Any model: managed through the Elastic Inference Service, or bring your own self-hosted LLM.
- AI is built into every solution: Attack Discovery, AI Assistant, Automatic Migration.
why-cost.html:
- Takeaway 3: cost efficiency.
- LogsDB cuts log index size by up to 75%.
- Data tiers keep older data cheap, and searchable snapshots keep it queryable without rehydration.
- Resource-based pricing on Self-managed and Cloud Hosted: no per-query, per-host or per-endpoint fees. Serverless is usage-priced.
thank-you.html:
- Recap the three reasons: unified, AI-driven, cost efficient.
- Point partners to elastic.co/partners.
